label: What is more in being than another is in act in some respect the other is not
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: whenever y is more in being than x, y is in act in some respect in which x is not. After the reading of grades of being as grades of act (ST I q.4 a.2; q.2 a.3, quarta via). Interpretation gap: with the binary InAct, things in act in the same respects cannot differ in being, so a reading on which grades are intensities of one act makes this bridge fail unless respects separate grades.
